Cuando Volvimos A La Tierra

  • 13min
  • USA
  • Cine De Riesgo

Synopsis

An astronaut recreating Martian conditions in the American desert is rescued by two passing immigrants. They begin negotiating over his water, essential both to his mission to save humanity and to their survival on the journey.

Written & directed by
Pablo Riesgo Almonacid
Cast
Ptolemy SlocumGabriel RomeroJorlhey Novelo
Supported by
Spotlight Dorado Grant

About the film

Cuando Volvimos A La Tierra is the story of a billionaire who dreams of going to Mars and two immigrants who dream of living peacefully on Earth.
